g.text: The copying heads do not pass the rest at twice the J++ part
Fixed in advance; medians over items, 95% intervals.
Each row: one of the five heads that copy most from the bridge word. How much of each part
of the change the head passes; thin line: 2 × the J++ part. Rule: the rest at or past it
(random part not above the rest) on 3 of 5 heads, on both models; right: per head.
the rest (the change minus its J++ part)
